final: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), qualifying_names AS (SELECT name, total_points FROM race_totals WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_totals)) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM qualifying_names) AS combined_total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_totals)) FROM qualifying_names) AS average_excess_points FROM qualifying_names AS q JOIN races AS r ON r.name = q.name JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
